the_ruling_verbatim: i've also realized we have at least 3 entry points: IDEA, INTENT and TICKET even tho they're not all skills yet. But a bug should really go straight to ticket unless is a deeply structural bug i think.

let's define deeply structural, because that's the same kind of thing that catches you up consistently: if we have to edit lines of code to fix it, then it's not deeply structural... but if new information breaks the harmony of the system (eg an intention was implemented in a way contrary to the actual intention) with that version you and i have to reconcile it. that's structural.
now_the_spec_says: Three entry points — IDEA, INTENT, TICKET; a bug enters at TICKET. "Deeply structural" is level, not size: if editing code fixes it, it is a ticket; if new information breaks the system's harmony (an intention implemented contrary to the intention), Akien and I reconcile it.
